summary: Horizontal admin audit — all 24 admin surfaces (21 tool cards + AdminIndex + 2 extra) and their backing APIs tested. Backend: 55/55 pytest tests pass (40 admin GET endpoints across every AdminIndex tool + 10 unauth 401/403 probes + 3 write-action dry-runs + 1 non-admin-403 probe + audit-faces dry-run). Frontend: all 24 /admin/* routes render without React crash under an admin session token; no admin GET endpoint returns 5xx; no admin GET endpoint 4xx-fails for an admin caller. Two pages emit a benign React hydration warning (`<span>` is not a valid child of `<option>`) but still render fully. Every admin action button endpoint spot-checked: POST /api/admin/avatars/audit-faces?dry_run=true → 200 {ok, scanned}; POST /api/admin/billing/enforce-zero-credit-policy {dry_run:true} → 200 {ok, dry_run:true, scanned}; POST /api/admin/renewal-reminders/run → 200. Non-admin user with valid session is correctly 403'd by /api/admin/chats.

minor.issue: Requires q with min_length=1; empty q returns 422 (correct schema-level rejection, but frontend AdminUsers should either default q='a' or show a placeholder search prompt instead of firing an empty query on mount).

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: `<span>` cannot be a child of `<option>` (violates HTML spec). Renders but pollutes console.
Same hydration warning (span inside option). Renders but pollutes console.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In AdminAntiAbuse.jsx and AdminWebhookLogs.jsx, unwrap the inline `<span>` from inside `<option>` (or drop the span entirely) to silence the React hydration warning — cosmetic, does not affect functionality.

OPTIONAL: AdminUsers.jsx could avoid the initial 422 by not firing /billing/users/search until the user types at least 1 char (currently my test with q='' returns 422 which is expected server-side but the page might issue that call on mount).
critical_code_review_comments: All 21 admin tool cards in AdminIndex.jsx map to real, non-500 backend endpoints — no dead cards found.
RBAC is enforced correctly: unauthenticated requests get 401/403 (never 500) and non-admin authenticated users get 403 on every probed admin endpoint (chats, spot-checked).
billing_api.py `enforce-zero-credit-policy` accepts optional payload dict and correctly honours dry_run=true — no writes, returns full sample. Good.
admin_avatars.py `audit-faces` dry_run works with query params — 200/ok/scanned shape confirmed.
One-shot renewal-reminders `/run` accepts dry_run body and returns 200 — safe to click from the Renewal Reminders card.
The `/api/admin/billing/users/search` Pydantic constraint `min_length=1` is correct at API level but the frontend page should not call it with empty q on mount (see minor issue above).
